active_findings.description: Detected Apache httpd 2.4.x below the patched line for CVE-2026-12345. Remote attackers can achieve code execution via a crafted Content-Length header.
active_findings.remediation: Upgrade httpd to the vendor-patched line; restart the service; validate with a rescan.
active_findings.title: Outdated Apache httpd — CVE-2026-12345 (RCE)

active_findings.description: The /go endpoint reflects the target= parameter in a 302 Location header without origin validation.
active_findings.remediation: Validate target= against an allowlist of internal hosts; reject external URLs.
active_findings.title: Open Redirect via /go endpoint
